motion_plan.primary_action: Reveal the whole fruit before the cutaway

motion_plan.primary_action: Separate two skin halves and reveal the seeds
motion_plan.camera: Orbit slightly toward the opened centre
motion_plan.learning_purpose: Explain where the seed is, not decorative bouncing

motion_plan.primary_action: Keep extracted green seeds in focus

motion_plan.primary_action: Green-to-brown illustrative roast transition with heat cues

visual_prompt: Original EGON 3D coffee explainer: dark purple teaching stage, warm lighting, object close-ups and purposeful camera pushes. Coffee fruit opens to reveal seeds, green seeds lead to roasting, simplified grinding, one illustrative pour-over, then a concise curiosity close. Nara guide appears only as a small closing character. Use the original complete EGON wordmark via the registered colour-managed display pipeline. Public Motion Format examples inform general motion craft only; no course skill, artwork, shot sequence, voice or source code is copied. These are schematic illustrations, not physical EGON lab tests.
